name: @nodeve/schema
description: Central schema source for describing things, authored as a relational LinkML model and projected for storage, validation, and code.

scripts.generate: node format.ts && node normalize/catalog.ts && node data2schema.ts
scripts.build: pnpm generate && pnpm check:catalog && pnpm build:ddl && pnpm build:db
scripts.check:catalog: cd linkml && uvx --from linkml linkml-validate -s nodeve.yaml -C Catalog ../gen/catalog.json
scripts.build:db: cd linkml && uvx --from linkml python ../ddl.py dump
scripts.validate: cd linkml && uvx --from linkml linkml-validate -s ../gen/nodeve-projected.yaml -C Inverter ../data/device_model/foxess-h3-ps10sh.yaml
